segments.text: If you're an innovative laser in design, it's neat to see a laser and just say the word
segments.zh: 如果你在 Innovative Laser and Design，看激光很有意思，只要一说“激光”

segments.text: Everybody wants to come look at the laser.
segments.zh: 大家都想过来看看激光，

segments.text: And they're going to go home and tell their friends about that.
segments.zh: 而且他们回家后会把这件事告诉朋友。

segments.text: We have Class D fire extinguisher.
segments.zh: 我们配备了 D 类灭火器。
